result.title: Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
result.summary: Self-supervised video representation learning has achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale unlabeled video data. Recent methods commonly extend Masked Image Modeling (MIM) to Masked Video Modeling (MVM), where video representations are learned by capturing semantic information from temporal contexts during masked content recovery. Unlike static images, videos exhibit inherent temporal variation, as visual objects continuously change their positions, appearances, and motion states across frames. Therefore, MVM needs to preserve semantic consistency while capturing temporal changes of corresponding regions, which raises two central challenges: 1) how to establish reliable temporal correspondence across frames, and 2) how to formulate an appropriate representation learning objective for modeling both semantic consistency and temporal variation. To address these challenges, we propose Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for video Representation learning (VT-CoRe) framework. For challenge 1), VT-CoRe introduces a sandwich sampling strategy to construct two-sided temporal references and a Patch Registration Module (PRM) to establish reliable patch-level correspondence. For challenge 2), VT-CoRe imposes latent-space semantic alignment on registered representations through a self-distillation architecture and further proposes temporal variation modeling to constrain representation trajectories over time. Experiments on 8 downstream tasks across 16 benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of VT-CoRe across pixel-level, frame-level, video-level, and vision-based robotic learning scenarios. Complementary representation analysis shows that VT-CoRe learns a more structured latent space for variation-aware temporal correspondence learning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VT-CoRe 自监督视频表征学习框架：用 sandwich 采样构建双侧时序参考、以 Patch Registration Module 建立 patch 级时序对应，并通过自蒸馏在 latent 空间做语义对齐与时间变化建模，约束表征随时间的变化轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 属视频 MVM 预训练而非 VLM 推理，但其 patch 级时序对应与对 latent 表征轨迹的显式约束，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理状态更新的建模提供可核查线索。
